traits.name: Natural Swimmer
traits.summary: Always add your proficiency bonus on Strength (Athletics) checks to swim, dive, or stay afloat.

traits.name: Storm Sense
traits.summary: Always know whether a storm will strike your location before the next dawn; advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made to predict the weather.

traits.name: Coral Crafting
traits.summary: Double PB on checks to craft, repair, or appraise items made of coral, pearl, shell, or other sea-grown materials.

traits.name: Tidal Attunement
traits.summary: Always know the tide and the next high and low tides; after 1 minute studying a coastline, identify safe landing, anchoring, shelter, and hazards beneath the waterline.
traits.noEffect: Tides and coastal hazards are not simulated.

traits.name: Guiding Song
traits.summary: Sing with a power that carries for miles over open water; any creature that hears the song can unerringly find its way to you.

traits.name: Master Navigator
traits.summary: Never become lost at sea except by magic; advantage on Survival checks made at sea.

traits.name: Abyssal Adaptation
traits.summary: Take no damage from water pressure and survive at any depth.

traits.name: Deep Sight
traits.summary: See normally in complete darkness underwater.
traits.noEffect: Underwater darkness beyond darkvision is not simulated separately.

traits.name: Delver of the Underlakes
traits.summary: While underwater or in flooded caves, always know depth below the surface and the direction to open air; cannot become lost in freshwater cave systems except by magic.

traits.name: Freshwater Dweller
traits.summary: Double PB on Intelligence (Nature) checks concerning freshwater plants, creatures, or waters, including whether water is safe to drink.

traits.name: Salt Strain
traits.summary: While swimming in salt water, swimming speed is reduced by 10 feet.
